notes: Jeremiah 48:30 30 I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but [it shall] not [be] so; his lies shall not so effect [it].
Jeremiah 48:38 38 [There shall be] lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein [is] no pleasure, saith the LORD.
